description: Source code for font table loading functions in FreeType, specifically for TrueType font tables such as 'head', 'maxp', 'name', 'cmap', 'OS/2', 'post', 'pclt', and 'gasp'. It includes functions for locating, reading, and validating font tables within a font file.

methods.name: tt_face_lookup_table
methods.description: Finds a TrueType table by its tag within a font face, returning a pointer to its directory entry or NULL if not found.

methods.name: tt_face_goto_table
methods.description: Seeks the stream to the specified TrueType table by its tag, returning its length if found.

methods.name: check_table_dir
methods.description: Validates the font's table directory, checks for essential tables, and verifies magic numbers.

methods.name: tt_face_load_font_dir
methods.description: Loads the font's SFNT header and table directory, validating and sanitizing entries.

methods.name: tt_face_load_any
methods.description: Loads any font table or entire font file into memory, given a table tag and offset.

methods.name: tt_face_load_generic_header
methods.description: Loads the 'head' or 'bhed' font header table.

methods.name: tt_face_load_head
methods.description: Loads the 'head' table of a font.

methods.name: tt_face_load_bhed
methods.description: Loads the 'bhed' table of a font (if embedded bitmaps option is enabled).

methods.name: tt_face_load_maxp
methods.description: Loads the maximum profile ('maxp') table, including glyph counts and limits.

methods.name: tt_face_load_name
methods.description: Loads the name records from the 'name' table.

methods.name: tt_face_free_name
methods.description: Frees the name records and associated strings.

methods.name: tt_face_load_os2
methods.description: Loads the OS/2 table with font metrics and style info.

methods.name: tt_face_load_gasp
methods.description: Loads the 'gasp' table for grid-fitting and rendering options.
